ud2.10:1.2: ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā anupiyāyaṃ viharati ambavane.
ud2.10:1.3: tena kho pana samayena āyasmā bhaddiyo kāḷigodhāya putto araññagato’pi rukkhamūlagato’pi suññāgāragato’pi abhikkhaṇaṃ udānaṃ udānesi:
ud2.10:2.1: assosuṃ kho sambahulā bhikkhū āyasmato bhaddiyassa kāḷigodhāya puttassa araññagatassa’pi rukkhamūlagatassa’pi suññāgāragatassa’pi abhikkhaṇaṃ udānaṃ udānentassa
ud2.10:2.4: “nissaṃsayaṃ kho āvuso āyasmā bhaddiyo kāḷigodhāya putto anabhirato brahmacariyaṃ carati,
ud2.10:2.5: yaṃ’sa pubbe agāriyabhūtassa rajjasukhaṃ, so tamanussaramāno araññagato’pi rukkhamūlagato’pi suññāgāragato’pi abhikkhaṇaṃ udānaṃ udāneti:
ud2.10:3.1: atha kho sambahulā bhikkhū yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkamiṃsu. upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdiṃsu. ekamantaṃ nisinnā kho te bhikkhū bhagavantaṃ etadavocuṃ:
ud2.10:3.2: “āyasmā bhante bhaddiyo kāḷigodhāya putto araññagato’pi rukkhamūlagato’pi suññāgāragato’pi abhikkhaṇaṃ udānaṃ udāneti:
ud2.10:3.4: nissaṃsayaṃ kho bhante āyasmā bhaddiyo kāḷigodhāya putto anabhirato brahmacariyaṃ carati.
ud2.10:3.5: yaṃ’sa pubbe agāriyabhūtassa rajjasukhaṃ, so tamanussaramāno araññagato’pi rukkhamūlagato’pi suññāgāragato’pi abhikkhaṇaṃ udānaṃ udāneti:
ud2.10:4.1: atha kho bhagavā aññataraṃ bhikkhuṃ āmantesi: –
ud2.10:4.2: “ehi tvaṃ bhikkhu, mama vacanena bhaddiyaṃ bhikkhuṃ āmantehi:
ud2.10:5.1: “evaṃ bhante”ti kho so bhikkhu bhagavato paṭissutvā yenāyasmā bhaddiyo kāḷigodhāya putto tenupasaṅkami. upasaṅkamitvā āyasmantaṃ bhaddiyaṃ kāḷigodhāya puttaṃ etadavoca
ud2.10:5.3: “evamāvuso”ti kho āyasmā bhaddiyo kāḷigodhāya putto tassa bhikkhuno paṭissutvā yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami. upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi. ekamantaṃ nisinnaṃ kho āyasmantaṃ bhaddiyaṃ kāḷigodhāya puttaṃ bhagavā etadavoca:
ud2.10:6.1: “saccaṃ kira tvaṃ bhaddiya, araññagato’pi rukkhamūlagato’pi suññāgāragato’pi abhikkhaṇaṃ udānaṃ udānesi:
ud2.10:7.1: “kiṃ pana tvaṃ bhaddiya, atthavasaṃ sampassamāno araññagato’pi rukkhamūlagato’pi suññāgāragato’pi abhikkhaṇaṃ udānaṃ udānesi:
ud2.10:7.3: “pubbe me bhante agāriyabhūtassa rajjaṃ kārentassa anto’pi antepure rakkhā susaṃvihitā ahosi, bahi’pi antepure rakkhā susaṃvihitā ahosi. anto’pi nagare rakkhā susaṃvihitā ahosi, bahi’pi nagare rakkhā susaṃvihitā ahosi. anto’pi janapade rakkhā susaṃvihitā ahosi bahi’pi janapade rakkhā susaṃvihitā ahosi.
ud2.10:7.4: so kho aha, bhante evaṃ rakkhito gopito santo bhīto ubbiggo ussaṅkī utrāsī vihāsiṃ.
ud2.10:7.5: etarahi kho panāhaṃ bhante araññagato’pi rukkhamūlagato’pi suññāgāragato’pi eko abhito anubbiggo anussaṅkī anutrāsī appossukko pannalomo paradavutto migabhūtena cetasā viharāmi.
ud2.10:7.6: idaṃ kho ahaṃ bhante atthavasaṃ sampassamāno araññagato’pi rukkhamūlagato’pi suññāgāragato’pi abhikkhaṇaṃ udānaṃ udānemi:
ud2.10:8.1: atha kho bhagavā etamatthaṃ viditvā tāyaṃ velāyaṃ imaṃ udānaṃ udānesi:
